title: NRL Labstracts No. 23 (June 10, 1966) front page with cosmic ray physics portrait
description: Front page of the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory newsletter "NRL LABSTRACTS," No. 23, dated June 10, 1966, with a head-and-shoulders portrait photograph of a man in glasses illustrating the article "Chair of Cosmic Ray Physics Established," which names Dr. Maurice M. Shapiro. The article mentions his role as Principal Investigator for Gemini Cosmic Ray Experiment S-9, lost on Gemini VIII and rescheduled for Gemini XI. Other articles cover USRL joining NRL, a guard-unit labor contract and a savings bond campaign.
